description: A link a human opens to buy a plan (pro or business) on a Stripe page branded Geocode AI. Free, and charges nothing: the person enters or confirms the card (never pass card details to a tool). With a key, the link is a Checkout page for that account (or, on a paid plan already, a page that confirms the switch, prorated). Without a key it is a Checkout page that collects the human's email and creates their account when they pay (kind guest_checkout), so an agent with no account can still hand its human one link. Give the url to the human as is, say the plan and price (monthly by default; yearly: true bills ten months' price once a year), then call get_account to see when it is paid. Never open or pay it yourself, and only call it when the human asked to buy or upgrade.

plan.description: The plan to buy. get_pricing lists them with prices, limits and features.

yearly.description: Bill once a year: ten months' price (two months free). get_pricing shows price.yearly.
